name: Sarah
intro: Sarah has been instructing since 2000 and is an examiner for the Royal Kennel Club Good Citizen Dog Scheme at all levels. She is also a canine first aider.
detail: Her current dogs are rescue crossbreed Dougal, who has his Gold GCDS and a Bronze sniffer dog award, and Norfolk terrier Toby, who has his Bronze GCDS and eight first places at Crufts.
